# Sudalai Manikandan S — Founder of CRACKYYY.TECH

> Sudalai Manikandan S is an Indian IT professional, software developer and AI/ML engineer from Tenkasi, Tamil Nadu, India. He is the founder and owner of CRACKYYY.TECH, a software development, artificial intelligence, data and automation brand. He builds web applications, machine-learning systems, data pipelines and business automation with Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Django, Flask, OpenCV, YOLO, NLTK and scikit-learn.
